tools.name: crm_find_contacts

tools.name: crm_save_contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update the one with this email if it already exists. Only the fields you send change; tags are added, custom fields merged. Without an email a new contact is always created. Costs $0.01 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_save_contacts
tools.description: Create or update up to 100 contacts in one call, each exactly like crm_save_contact (matched by email; without an email a new contact is made). Each one succeeds or fails on its own; the reply lists which, and you pay only for the ones saved. Costs $0.01 per record saved; nothing if none are found.

tools.name: crm_update_contact
tools.description: Change fields on an existing contact by id. Only the fields you send change; tags are added, custom fields merged. Costs $0.01 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_archive_contact
tools.description: Hide a contact from searches and lists. Its history is kept; crm_update_contact cannot un-archive, crm_restore_contact does. Costs $0.001 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_restore_contact
tools.description: Bring an archived contact back. Costs $0.001 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact (by contact id or email), a deal or a company: what was said, decided or learned. A note on a deal also shows on its company's and contact's timelines. Costs $0.01 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_create_task
tools.description: A follow-up on a contact, with an optional due time (ISO 8601) and priority. Costs $0.01 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks by status (default open), optionally for one contact or due before a time, soonest first, each with the contact it is about (id, name, email). Free.

tools.name: crm_complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task done (or cancelled). Costs $0.01 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_save_company
tools.description: Create a company, or update the one with this name (case-insensitive). With company_id, update that company instead, and a name renames it. Only the fields you send change; tags are added, custom fields merged. Costs $0.01 per call; nothing if it fails.

tools.name: crm_archive_company
tools.description: Hide a company from crm_find_companies, crm_search, duplicates and exports. Its people, deals and notes stay as they are, and crm_get_company still reads it (archived: true). tools.name: crm_restore_company

tools.name: crm_save_companies

tools.name: crm_find_companies

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
